title: Manage IT customer relationships
goal: Every function that depends on IT has a named way to ask for something and to hear back, IT knows what each one is trying to do next, and no requirement sits unanswered or unrecorded.

steps.do: Propose to the founder how a function asks IT for something and how it hears back (a handoff to the IT agent, a standing item in the lead's meeting, a decision for anything that widens access or costs money), and let the founder set it; a way of working between people is theirs to establish.
Read each depending function's live goals and its lead plan and write one line per function on what it is trying to do in the next quarter and what that will ask of its systems.
For each function, list the systems it actually works in, the records it owns and the ones it only reads, and name every place where it works in a system the connection records do not have.

Tell each function, in one short message, which of its next-quarter needs its present access already covers and which would need a new connection, wider access, a paid plan or new terms, naming the decision each of those would raise.

Keep one list on the handoff of every request IT has received with who asked, what for, its state (open, in progress, done, refused with the reason) and the decision it waits on, and close nothing silently.
Add each unanswered request and each system the records lack to the decision it bears on as evidence, and propose to the product lead the order in which to answer them.

done_criteria.check: Does every request IT has received have a state and either an answer or the decision it waits on, and does every system a function works in have a connection record?
